approval.scope: desktop and mobile Evolution Garden layout, flower-map visual language, interaction direction

claim: Today's AI boom grew from older research lineages through repeated cycles of breakthrough, expectation, disappointment, accumulation, adoption, and response.
evidence_invariants: Never present unlike evidence sources as one continuously comparable public-interest index.
Petal radii are normalized within the selected evidence series and era; they do not compare absolute interest across unlike methods.
Every milestone, petal series, and interpretive label exposes its source and evidence status.
2026 is labeled H1 or partial-year wherever used.
Breakthrough, setback, harm, and governance events use redundant endpoint shapes in addition to color.

first_screen_density.desktop: masthead + title/thesis + reading key + complete branching garden + selected bloom lens + era navigation + source links
first_screen_density.mobile: masthead + concise thesis + selected era title + one large bloom + evidence status + previous/next and era stepper

tokens.display_font: Georgia, Iowan Old Style, Times New Roman, serif
tokens.shadow: selected lens only; soft archival lift

sections.asset_role: HTML text and semantic links; no baked text
data-bound inline SVG; no bitmap substitute
sections.renderer: native SVG with pure geometry/data modules
pass_criteria: one selected mobile bloom visible without horizontal scroll

sections.mobile_strategy: collapsible below selected bloom, never above first visualization
pass_criteria: evidence statuses use shape plus color

sections.mobile_strategy: selected bloom is the main panel; event detail opens below without hiding it
sections.asset_role: data-bound SVG plus HTML detail region
pass_criteria: selected event clear without relying on color

sections.desktop_strategy: scroll chapters below the complete garden; garden becomes sticky for guided mode
sections.mobile_strategy: stacked readable chapters after the interactive first screen
sections.asset_role: HTML narrative and small data-bound SVG charts
pass_criteria: each scene valid as a still

sections.mobile_strategy: accordion with direct link target and all content in DOM

functional_controls.must_not_do: no tiny visible mark as sole hit target

icon_system.strategy: typographic chevrons drawn with CSS borders; no icon package required

mobile_rules: Main bloom appears before the reading key and long prose.
No desktop SVG scaling; recompute flower radius, labels, and branch geometry.
Tap/focus replaces hover and previous/next replaces precise pointing.
No one-finger drag or pinch ownership; native page scroll remains untouched.
must_not_substitute: Do not replace the flower map with cards, a conventional line chart, or a generic dashboard grid.
Do not use the approved mockup PNG as the production visualization.
Do not add generic AI gradients, glow, particles, glass panels, or dark cyber styling.
Do not copy the supplied reference's open-book layout, purple-petal system, or publication identity.
accepted_deviations: Mobile uses one bloom at a time rather than the complete branching garden.
Production geometry may shift for label collision and responsive fit while preserving hierarchy and flower-map semantics.
